NC-001.reason: callmodule (58000) binds the contract loopback by default (global_config uses defaultBindHost; launcher, linux_service, windows_tray and ncore_module_caller.js follow). cors('*') is replaced by the K7 guard as the first middleware, with raw-body capture and the signed body-digest check. /api/call runs only exact {module, function} pairs from allowedCalls (empty by default); absolute, drive-letter and escaping module paths are rejected, and a whole module can no longer be invoked. A web page or LAN host can no longer require() arbitrary modules.

NC-005.reason: The shared HTTP RPC stack defaults to the contract loopback (rpc_constants, rpc_config, ExpressServer). expressProvider runs the guard first, reflects only allowed origins (never * with credentials), and checks the signed body digest. WsManager/WsRpcServer upgrades use createWsVerifyClient. /rpc/query results are bound to the requesting client id (ResponseCache owner).

NC-007.reason: WebLocalAreaNetwork serves and accepts uploads only under <ROOT_APP_STATIC_DIR>/share on a loopback bind (HTTP_HOST unset, so the stack default applies). Containment uses pathtool.resolveInside (realpath of the existing prefix plus path.relative), so sibling-prefix and symlink escapes are rejected. Upload names are reduced to basename and the dir picker is contained.

NC-013.reason: SessionManager runs an unref'd cleanup interval, caps sessions (evicting the oldest) and validates client ids (normalizeClientId); the WS close handler reads the entry before deleting and ignores superseded sockets.

NC-020.reason: jsmcptools replaces @fastify/cors '*' with the fastify guard (onRequest + preParsing): loopback Host, loopback origins plus the extension origin from service_contract.json#mcp_chrome.extension_id (now present in the contract), and K3 for non-loopback callers.

NC-028.reason: The translation HTTP service listens on the contract loopback (or the configured host) behind the express guard and the body-digest check.

NC-038.reason: New finding, accepted: Node package imports do no extension/index resolution, so the extensionless #@ requires threw MODULE_NOT_FOUND. The 24 require strings now carry the file path; only the require string changed in each file. The unresolved targets that do not exist at all are listed as dead in the report.

NC-039.reason: New finding, accepted: rpc.getExpressServer() never existed; the Voice dict_server/sync_audio and WLAN update controllers now require UploadTools directly.
